✨ Religious Services At Masjid An-Nur ✨

Masjid An-Nur is pleased to offer a range of religious services to assist individuals and families in fulfilling their religious needs with confidence and ease at every stage of life.

Our services include:

👶 Newborn Package
(Tahnik, Tahlik & Aqiqah)

📖 Customised Home-Based Learning (New)
Tailored Islamic learning for individuals and families.

💍 Marriage Advice & Family Counselling
Professional guidance for strengthening family relationships.

🤝 Religious Advice
Consultation with our Asatizah on religious matters.

🏠 Home-Based Tahlil & Doa Selamat
For various occasions and milestones.

💰 Zakat / Fidyah / Kaffarah
Assistance in fulfilling your religious obligations.

📜 Islamic Wealth Consultation
(Faraidh, Wasiat, Hibah, Nuzriah & CPF Nomination)

🤲 Jenazah Prayer
Facilities available for funeral prayers by appointment.

📝 iWasiat (Islamic Will)
Plan your legacy according to Islamic principles.

📞 To enquire or book a service, contact us at 9071 9510.

We look forward to serving you and your family with care, professionalism and compassion.
